name: AJ Donavon

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Valor Champion; eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Bobby Dynamite)
tenures.hometown: Toronto, Ontario, Canada (Now Residing in Miami, Florida)

caption: Signed back to eWo as the reigning UX Uncensored Champion looking for a first World title, carrying a Valor Championship and a tag reign from his earlier eWo run and a standing partnership with Reno Drake as the Iconoclast.

name: C.M. Vyrus

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Champion; eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Ryley Wynters)
tenures.finisher: Veneno Mortiféro — combination STF/Border City Stretch

entrance_music.verbatim: "A Dagger Through the Heart of St. Angeles" by Alexisonfire
entrance_music.title: A Dagger Through the Heart of St. Angeles

caption: A ten-year veteran billed out of Chicago by way of Mexico who wrestled submissions and lucha at once, held the eWo Championship, and reunited Nuclear Wynter with Ryley Wynters — the partner whose violent streak he had encouraged into existence in the first place.

name: Eden Turner

tenures.hometown: Port Royal, Jamaica (Now residing in Minneapolis, Minnesota
tenures.style: high-flyer and risk taker, with submissions

caption: The Queen of Xtreme, billed out of Port Royal and trained by Adriana Garcia — the first woman to win the LWA Heavyweight Championship and its last holder, who came to eWo alongside her husband Nick Toretto after four straight federations closed under her.

name: Freddy "Little Papi" Castro

tenures.style: A little Luchador mixed with Shawn Micheals.

caption: A Cuban-flag-waving Miami cruiserweight who came up through AAA and HIW, entered behind a line of dancers and a lit cigar, and worked eWo's undercard through the spring of 2008.

name: Jack Darling

tenures.style: technical, with strong strikes to weak points

entrance_music.verbatim: "Battle Without Honor or Humanity" by Tomoyasu Hotei
entrance_music.title: Battle Without Honor or Humanity
entrance_music.corrected: "Battle Without Honor or Humanity" by Tomoyasu Hotei

caption: The first eWo Freedom Champion — a Philadelphia trust-fund heel who trained in Calgary, Europe, Mexico and Japan and went out of his way to be hated for it.

name: Nick Toretto

tenures.style: Purely technical with a few power moves and some submissions

caption: The Prototype — a Minneapolis gym owner and three-time BWF United States Champion who never got his shot at that company's top belt, and who arrived in eWo alongside his wife Eden Turner to try again.

name: Nijs Landzaat

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Television Champion; eWo Freedom Champion
tenures.finisher: The Overheersing — belly-to-belly suplex into the corner

caption: A Dutch powerhouse managed by Daniel Singh who held both the eWo Television Championship and the Freedom Championship, ended Erin Jacobs' winning streak, and left the promotion when the contract talks stalled.

name: Paul Herring
caption: The New King — a third-generation wrestler who left his family's training facilities and stopped speaking to them, spent two years winning everything WPW had, and returned to the ring in the spring of 2008 with no title history to his name anywhere else.

name: Reno Drake

tenures.role: wrestler, then chairman — first eWo Commonwealth Champion; 2007 Dominance Award
tenures.finisher: The Dark Vendetta — sit-down Last Ride

caption: The Don Diablo — first eWo Commonwealth Champion, winner of the first AJ Epic Memorial Cup and of the 2007 Dominance Award, who took ownership of the promotion from Cody Clark's parents, was shot outside a Toronto nightclub and left in a coma, and came back anyway.

name: Ryley Wynters

tenures.role: wrestler — first eWo Television Champion; eWo Commonwealth, Valor and Tag-Team Champion

caption: A split-personality Australian who worked ultraviolent and apathetic by turns, first eWo Television Champion and a Commonwealth, Valor and tag-team champion besides — half of Nuclear Wynter, and the fed's own Quote of the Week in April 2008.

name: The Legend

identity.note: Shares the bare ring name with the aka "The Legend" already registered to rob-williams (IWF, 1998). Nothing else matches — different decade, different billing, different record — and the two are filed as separate in-universe characters per the generic-name doctrine.

caption: A two-time eWo Champion out of Cincinnati whose whole gimmick was four words — the man who walked out of BWF Danger Zone 2007 carrying its championship, laid it down in the ring, and held up an eWo belt instead.

name: William Diamond

tenures.alignment: Neutral, but due to his natural affinity for being an asshole, he leans towards being a Heel.
tenures.style: High Flying and Submission moves, but mostly brawling

caption: A Halifax brawler with a two-count assault conviction written into his own bio, a two-time SCW World Heavyweight Champion who would rather throw chairs than wrestle.

name: Xaria Linette

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Alexis Sykes)
tenures.style: martial arts and aerial, with submissions

caption: The Rainbow Angel — a Paris-born babyface staged as schizophrenic, first LWA Crossfire and Undisputed World Champion, an eWo Tag-Team Champion with Alexis Sykes, and one of the group that walked out of BWF Danger Zone 2007.

name: AJ Epic
caption: Founded the promotion that carried his name in August 2004 and was its chairman for four months; the fed staged his disappearance and death, closed itself over them, and named a tournament after him that ran twice.

name: Blake Price
caption: Co-founded eWo in August 2004 and ran it as Commissioner beside AJ Epic; when the chairman went missing it was Price who made the decision to close the company.

name: Cody Clark

tenures.role: chairman and owner — the Epic Messiah

tenures.source: Named on W3's own pages for 12 August, 19 August, 26 August, 16 September 2007 and on its title pages.

caption: A four-time World Champion who signed with eWo in its first run without ever having a match, bought the dormant company outright in 2007, built it an arena in Toronto called the Thunderdome, lost it to Reno Drake through his own parents, and won it back in a Canadian court.

identity.note: NLWF's Tails (2009) also carries the epithet The Epic Messiah. Nothing on W3's pages names Tails, NLWF, Johnny Styles or the Heart Attacks, and the NLWF record is itself kept apart from the eWo Cody Clark; the shared epithet alone joins nothing.

name: Bill Dynamite

tenures.role: wrestler — first eWo Champion; eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Czecher); acting Chairman

caption: The Idol — first eWo Champion, beating Dylan Dunn two falls to one at the promotion's own first pay-per-view in September 2004, a tag champion with Czecher, and later its acting Chairman.

name: Dylan Dunn

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo World Heavyweight Champion; 2x eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Scott Royal)

caption: The Dealer — lost the two-out-of-three-falls tournament final that crowned eWo's first champion, then held the World Heavyweight Championship himself and the tag titles twice with Scott Royal.

name: Lawrence Jarvis

tenures.role: wrestler — first eWo National Champion; eWo Primetime Champion; Hall of Famer

caption: First eWo National Champion and a Primetime Champion, an eight-time World Champion elsewhere who led the Dynasty in px:w, and the man Reno Drake fought in a Last Man Standing match at Supremacy 2007.

name: Czecher

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Champion; United States, Triple Crown and Gutz & Glory Champion; eWo Tag Team Champion (w/ Bill Dynamite)

caption: The only eWo Triple Crown Champion on the fed's own Hall of Fame page — eWo Champion, United States Champion, Gutz & Glory Champion and tag champion with Bill Dynamite.

name: Johnny Legend
caption: Won a ladder match at Bound for Glory to become the first eWo Primetime Champion, starting a title that outlived the promotion by three federations.

name: Gabe Shelley

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Primetime Champion, the last one

caption: The last eWo Primetime Champion, who carried the belt out of the closed promotion and into the Blazenwing Wrestling Federation on his own initiative.

name: Scott Royal

tenures.role: wrestler — 2x eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Dylan Dunn)

caption: A two-time eWo Tag-Team Champion with Dylan Dunn whose exit the fed staged as a kidnapping, an arson and three deaths in a warehouse — the story eWo told to explain why it closed in December 2004.

name: Erin Jacobs

tenures.role: referee, then wrestler — 2007 BodyCount Award winner

caption: Refereed the two-out-of-three-falls match that crowned eWo's first champion in 2004, and by 2007 was main-eventing Supremacy against The Legend and taking the fed's own BodyCount Award.

name: Chris Roman

tenures.source: Named on W3's own pages for 12 August, 19 August, 26 August, 16 September, 23 September 2007.

caption: Walked out of BWF Danger Zone 2007 stitched up and at Cody Clark's shoulder, was handed the eWo United States Championship in the middle of the ring, and laid it straight back down.

name: Jerry Tans
caption: The face half of eWo's commentary team across both of its later runs, hired on a lifetime contract, briefly its acting Chairman, and handed that job straight to Bill Dynamite after Danny Allan threatened him.

name: Roger Steck
caption: The heel half of eWo's commentary team, modelled on early Jerry Lawler, who cheered the cheating and then went publicly furious when his own partner was threatened.

name: Danny Allan
caption: eWo's General Manager under three different owners, overruled at every turn by Bill Dynamite before the 2007 closure, who came back after the reopening and appointed his own wife as his co-General Manager.

name: Adriana Garcia-Allan
caption: A former World Champion who wrestled in eWo's earlier run and returned to it as co-General Manager beside her husband; Eden Turner's own trainer, met in a Texas kickboxing gym.

name: Frank Murdoch
caption: Won a number-one-contenders match and then pinned The Legend at The New Black to end his 126-day reign and become eWo Champion — the last title change the surviving record holds before the promotion closed on 25 November 2007, known only through two other wrestlers' own roster-card retrospectives, with no roster card of his own.

identity.note: Coincidence, not a collision: frank-uwf is Dr Franken's own reanimated-monster gimmick in UWF (2002), billed bare as "Frank" with no surname — sharing nothing with eWo's own Frank Murdoch but the decorated substring.

name: Bobby Dynamite

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ AJ Donavon)

caption: AJ Donavon's own eWo Tag-Team Championship partner, per Donavon's title history — undated against either of the promotion's two runs, known only from that one credit and a passing mention as Jasmine Kent's old boyfriend, with no roster card of his own.

identity.note: Coincidence, not a collision: dynamite-faw is a bare archetype gimmick name ("Dynamite"), a single FAW debut win in March 2002 with no surname, no title history and no other detail in common with eWo's own Bobby Dynamite.

Coincidence, not a collision: dynamite-wwa is a bare archetype gimmick name ("Dynamite"), one half of WWA's own Detonators tag team from late 2005, sharing nothing but the decorated substring with eWo's own Bobby Dynamite.

name: Alexis Sykes

tenures.role: wrestler — eWo Tag-Team Champion (w/ Xaria Linette)

caption: Named among the second coming's own returning and rising roster, carded against Melissa Chavez on the 11 November 2007 Violence card, an eWo Tag-Team Champion with Xaria Linette in the Iconoclast's wider stable, and a repeat challenger for The Legend's eWo Championship — a Guilty As Charged triple threat and an Ultimate Tables Match, both losing efforts recorded only in other wrestlers' own roster-card retrospectives.

name: Seth Thomas
caption: One of the three men the fed's own history credits with holding the Primetime Championship between Johnny Legend's founding reign and Gabe Shelley's closing one — named once, in that one sentence, and nowhere else in the surviving record.

name: Scott Free
caption: Named winner of the AJ Epic Memorial Cup (2007), the EWO's own award named for held character AJ Epic.

name: Andrew Matters
caption: Billed against Chris Maddox on the eWo Violence card of 18 May 2008 and in the fatal four-way on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed against Chris Maddox on the 18 May 2008 Violence card; in the fatal four-way (with Chris Maddox, Mike Savage and Paul Herring) on the Hell and Back card.

name: Chris Maddox
caption: Billed against Andrew Matters on the eWo Violence card of 18 May 2008 and in the fatal four-way on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed against Andrew Matters on the 18 May 2008 Violence card; in the fatal four-way on the Hell and Back card.

name: Mike Savage
caption: Billed in a tag match with Nick Toretto on the eWo Violence card of 20 April 2008 and in the fatal four-way on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed with Nick Toretto against Nijs Landzaat and The Slugger on the 20 April 2008 Violence card (violence-2008-04-20-card.html); in the fatal four-way on the Hell and Back card.

name: Eryk Adams
caption: Billed as the eWo Freedom Champion on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card and in a tag match on the Violence card of 18 May 2008.

tenures.note: Billed as the defending Freedom Champion (c) against Eden Turner on the Hell and Back card; teams with Erik Dafoe against Nick Carroll and Xaria Linette on the 18 May 2008 Violence card; the front page lists him with the champions.

name: Erik Dafoe
caption: The eWo Commonwealth Champion by the Violence card of 18 May 2008, billed to defend the belt against Juan Ramirez on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Named on the 18 May 2008 Violence card as the new Commonwealth Champion; billed as the defending champion (c) against Juan Ramirez on the Hell and Back card; the front page lists him with the champions.

identity.note: The name is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two (different federation, different years), so they are kept apart.

name: HIBAKUSHA
caption: Billed against Jacob Seldon on the eWo Violence card of 18 May 2008 and against Kelly Godless on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed against Jacob Seldon on the 18 May 2008 Violence card and against Kelly Godless on the Hell and Back card.

name: Kelly Godless
caption: Billed against HIBAKUSHA on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed against HIBAKUSHA on the Hell and Back card.

name: Juan Ramirez
caption: A challenger for the eWo Commonwealth Championship: in the triple threat on the card of 20 April 2008, the contendership match on 18 May and the title match on the Hell and Back pay-per-view card.

tenures.note: Billed in the Commonwealth triple threat on the 20 April 2008 Violence card (violence-2008-04-20-card.html); billed against Paul Herring in the Commonwealth contendership match on the 18 May 2008 Violence card; billed against Erik Dafoe for the title on the Hell and Back card.

identity.note: The name is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two (different federation, different years), so they are kept apart.

name: Jacob Seldon
caption: Billed against HIBAKUSHA on the eWo Violence card of 18 May 2008 and on Team Legend in the Hell and Back war games; the card says he need only take part to earn an eWo contract.

tenures.note: Billed against HIBAKUSHA on the 18 May 2008 Violence card; on The Legend's side of the war games match on the Hell and Back card, whose own preview says that, as long as he participates, he will get an eWo contract and be able to cash in "his money in the back contract".

identity.note: The name is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two (different federation, different years), so they are kept apart.

name: Nick Carroll
caption: Billed with Xaria Linette against Eryk Adams and Erik Dafoe on the eWo Violence card of 18 May 2008.

tenures.note: Billed with Xaria Linette against the Freedom and Commonwealth Champions on the 18 May 2008 Violence card.
